name: bug

name: enhancement
description: A new capability or improvement

name: documentation
description: Documentation additions or corrections

name: maintenance
description: Internal upkeep without intended user-facing behavior changes

name: question
description: A focused usage or support question

name: dependencies
description: Dependency additions or updates

description: A change requiring users to update existing behavior

name: good first issue
description: An approachable contribution for a new contributor

name: help wanted
description: A contribution from the wider community is welcome

name: status: needs information
description: Cannot proceed without additional information

name: status: blocked
description: Blocked by another decision, issue, or dependency

name: priority: high
description: Should be addressed before normal-priority work

name: priority: medium
description: Normal planning priority

name: priority: low
description: Useful but not time-sensitive

name: area: documentation
description: README files, guides, examples, or reference material

name: area: community
description: Contribution, conduct, issue, or pull request infrastructure

name: area: workflows
description: Automation, continuous integration, or deployment workflows

description: Already tracked by another issue or pull request

name: invalid
description: Does not contain an actionable or valid request

name: wontfix
description: Will not be addressed under the current project scope
